description: The angles in use across every tracked brand in the trailing window: the same shape as sightglass_find_angles, with the brand on each. Filter by angle type, the age band or awareness stage of the persona it speaks to, or a categoryId (e.g. the user's brand's category), and sort by ads, landing pages or newest. Whatever the sort, angles carried by ads come first and ones seen only on landing pages last. Use it for 'what pitches are brands using on this audience' and to find an angle nobody is running. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

categoryId.description: Scope to one industry category's subtree, e.g. the user's brand's: a brand's `category.id` from sightglass_get_company, or an id from sightglass_get_rankings.

limit.description: Most results to return: 20 by default, up to 50. Ones carried by ads come first.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_top_angles
title: Find angles across brands
